# error.raise inside an @click handler under a boundary lowers to an
# inlined handler body in the bubbletea output; the ErrorEvent struct is
# emitted because the package uses error handling.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=bb boundary.sngl
stdout 'bb/model.go'
exists bb/model.go
grep 'type ErrorEvent struct' bb/model.go
grep 'Message: "boom"' bb/model.go

# error.raise with no enclosing handler lowers to a panic.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --out=unhandled unhandled.sngl
grep 'panic\(ErrorEvent\{' unhandled/model.go

# html-static target: the inlined handler body appears inside a try/throw-less
# block-scope in the emitted JS. Propagate-native uses throw.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=htmlout unhandled.sngl
grep 'throw Object.assign' htmlout/index.html

-- boundary.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
    go() {
        bubbletea
    }
}

var lastErr = ""

component main node {
    vbox {
        boundary(@error(e) { lastErr = e.message }) {
            button(text="Go", @click { error.raise("boom", "") })
        }
        text(value=("Last: " + lastErr))
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- unhandled.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output {
    go() {
        bubbletea
    }
    none() {
        html
    }
}

component main node {
    button(text="Go", @click { error.raise("unhandled", "") })
}

window {
    main
}
